availability.note: No UK product information for a paracetamol + pseudoephedrine + chlorphenamine combination. The single-ingredient paracetamol entry in this tool is UK-sourced and can be checked separately; this entry is linked to the sympathomimetic and antihistamine groups (sourced in the batch file) so that group interactions of other medicines still show.
